## Meet the Team

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)

# 1. SETUP: Tell R we are accessing a PUBLIC sheet (no login required)
gs4_deauth()
sheet_id <- "1reSknnI2NfaYGdCovLiXL7rgnjXCJjLsgrc5rQ39xyw" # Replace with your ID

# 2. READ DATA: Pull the 'Staff' tab
# Make sure your Google Sheet tab is named exactly "Staff"
team_data <- read_sheet(sheet_id, sheet = "Staff")

cat('<div class="grid">')

for(i in 1:nrow(team_data)) {
  person <- team_data[i, ]
  
  # Image check logic: Uses placeholder if image column is empty
  photo_path <- paste0("images/team/", person$Photo)
  
  if (is.na(person$Photo) || !file.exists(photo_path)) {
    display_photo <- paste0("[https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=](https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=)", 
                            URLencode(as.character(person$Name)), 
                            "&background=random&rounded=true")
  } else {
    display_photo <- photo_path
  }

  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4 g-col-lg-3">',
      '<div class="flip-card">',
        '<div class="flip-card-inner">',
          
          # FRONT: Photo and Name
          '<div class="flip-card-front">',
            '<img src="', display_photo, '" class="rounded-circle mb-3" style="width: 150px; height: 150px; object-fit: cover;">',
            '<h4>', person$Name, '</h4>',
          '</div>',
          
          # BACK: Role, Bio, and Email
          '<div class="flip-card-back">',
            '<h5 class="mb-1">', person$Role, '</h5>', 
            '<p class="small">', person$Bio, '</p>',
            '<hr style="width: 50%; border-color: white; margin: 10px auto;">',
            '<a href="mailto:', person$Email, '" style="color: #abdbe3;">', person$Email, '</a>',
          '</div>',
          
        '</div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ))
}

cat('</div>')
```
